item.title: FedEx plane slides off Miami runway while landing during stormy weather, causes ground stop
item.description: A FedEx cargo plane slid off the runway at Miami International Airport on Wednesday. Kris Van Cleave reports.

item.title: Maps show where Thanksgiving storms could disrupt holiday
item.description: Rain, snow and powerful winds were forecast to impact large stretches of the country on Thanksgiving, potentially disrupting holiday festivities and, in some areas, hampering travel plans.

item.title: Shopping strategies to make the most of Black Friday deals
item.description: Trae Bodge, a lifestyle writer and smart shopping expert, joins "CBS Mornings" to share ways you can make the most of Black Friday deals.

item.title: Macy's parade postponed as inclement weather slams U.S.
item.description: The Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade was postponed until Saturday due to severe weather conditions Thursday. Meanwhile, it's snowing in the Midwest and there are flood warnings on both coasts. Rob Marciano reports.

item.title: The story behind this Eagles player's special Thanksgiving cleats
item.description: For Philadelphia Eagles cornerback Jonathan Jones, the team's slogan has a personal meaning that extends beyond the football field.

item.title: Here's why the Black Sea matters for NATO in the Russia-Ukraine war
item.description: Chris Livesay traveled to Romania to learn about the Black Sea's role in the Russia-Ukraine war, as its Navy works to fend off rogue attacks from Russia targeting Ukraine.

item.title: Questions swirl around Megaspeed and Nvidia amid Jensen Huang's reinstatement
item.description: Questions are swirling around Singapore-based company Megaspeed and its relationship to Nvidia and China amid a Justice Department probe. Weijia Jiang reports.

item.title: No lead detected in Iowa air after Army's detonation, EPA says
item.description: No lead has been detected in the air near the Army's controlled blast site in Iowa, where they detonated nearly five tons of lead explosives on Wednesday, according to the Environmental Protection Agency. Some locals remain concerned. Ian Lee reports.

item.title: Eagles' Jonathan Jones on taking his love of flying to new heights
item.description: The Philadelphia Eagles' Jonathan Jones initially went viral for flying himself to his contract signing. Now, he's talking with Kris Van Cleave about how he hopes to pass on his love of piloting and his charity that helps fly sick kids to medical appointments.

item.title: Eye Opener: Macy's parade postponed for severe weather
item.description: The Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade was postponed until Saturday for heavy winds and rain, which are expected throughout Thursday. All that and all that matters in today's Eye Opener.

item.title: FedEx cargo plane runs off MIA runway, causing brief ground stop
item.description: The Miami-Dade Fire-Rescue and Sheriff's Office both confirmed that two people were on board the plane and no injuries were reported.

item.title: Oil prices inch back up as Iran and the Houthis escalate threats
item.description: Increased fighting between Iran's Houthi allies and Saudi Arabia and Tehran's unrelenting threats in the Strait of Hormuz appear to be reversing weeks of oil price declines.

item.title: Ukraine says it downed a Russian jet-powered drone with a laser
item.description: Ukraine has used a laser weapon to shoot down a Russian jet-powered drone for the first time, a senior adviser to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says.

item.title: Fuel tanker explosion kills 31 on Egyptian highway
item.description: A massive fire killed 31 people in Egypt after a speeding driver allegedly crashed into a fuel tanker truck.

item.title: What's open and closed today on Thanksgiving Day 2026?
item.description: A handful of grocery stores will welcome customers on Thanksgiving this year, while most retailers will be closed. Here's what to know.

item.title: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade postponed for 1st time in history
item.description: For the first time in history, the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade has been postponed due to weather, Macy's said Wednesday.

item.title: Videos show California flooding, damage from king tides
item.description: King tides and monster waves hit coastal communities in California this week. Videos show the flooding, damage and mitigation efforts.

item.title: Trump owned millions in Nvidia stock as he pressed for Jensen Huang's reinstatement
item.description: President Trump holds tens of millions in Nvidia shares, giving him a personal stake in the company's stock market roller coaster ride of the past two weeks, financial disclosure documents show.

item.title: Army detonates toxic explosives at Iowa plant despite concerns
item.description: The U.S. Army detonated a stockpile of degrading explosives at a munitions plant in Iowa on Wednesday, after days of back-and-forth between politicians and the courts.

item.title: Judge temporarily blocks FCC from reviewing ABC's licenses
item.description: A federal judge blocked the FCC from moving forward with an early review of ABC's broadcast licenses, a move the network argues is an attempt by the Trump administration to punish speech it does not like.

item.title: A look at the probes involving Nvidia, Jensen Huang and Megaspeed
item.description: The reinstatement of Jensen Huang as president and CEO of Nvidia sent shockwaves through the political and business world, and has fueled scrutiny by Congress.

item.title: Jennifer Lopez's choreographer on what to expect from "The JLo Show"
item.description: Kiel Tutin, supervising choreographer for "The JLo Show," joins "The Daily Report" to discuss the film and Jennifer Lopez's intense Las Vegas residency. "The JLo Show" premieres Thursday night on CBS and Paramount+. Paramount+ is owned by CBS News' parent company, Skydance.

item.title: Butterball Turkey hotline ramps up staffing, prepared to help with Thanksgiving cooking needs
item.description: Even in the world of email, texting and artificial intelligence, the Butterball Turkey hotline has only gotten more popular. The larger team is prepared to field about 100,000 calls this holiday season to help with any turkey troubles. Tony Dokoupil has the story.

item.title: Tips for baking your best Thanksgiving bird with Butterball Turkey
item.description: From food safety to tips on preparing the best bird, the Butterball Turkey Talk-Line has helped hundreds of thousands of callers bake their best turkey since 1981. Mary Alice Coffey from the hotline joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: 11/25: CBS Evening News
item.description: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade is postponed until Saturday; Thanksgiving travelers rush to beat bad weather.

item.title: U.S.-based firms helping China access Nvidia's most advanced chips
item.description: It's not just Megaspeed. A CBS News investigation reveals that at least two California-based Nvidia customers have Chinese ownership — giving the U.S. adversary potential access to Nvidia's most advanced technology.

item.title: How a new generation of AI agents could change holiday shopping
item.description: The internet revolutionized holiday shopping by allowing people to make purchases without leaving their homes. Now, a new generation of AI agents is promising an even bigger change: Doing the shopping for you. Jared Ochacher reports on what to look out for if you're planning to hand over your holiday list to an AI agent this year.

item.title: 11/25: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: Weather postpones Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade; Trump introduces new tariffs on China, the EU and major trading partners.

item.title: Why are investors freaking out even as the U.S. economy surges?
item.description: The economy is sending mixed signals, with growth jumping while stocks gyrate. Here's what economists say is going on.

item.title: Titanic postcard sent days before doomed voyage sells for pricey sum
item.description: A postcard from Jack Phillips, the Titanic's chief radio officer, was postmarked April 6, 1912, four days before the ill-fated ship set sail.
